subject: Quantitative Aptitude
topic: Speed, Distance and Time — Relative Speed, Trains and Average Speed (W12 B1)

questions.stem: A car covers 240 km in 4 hours. What is its speed?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Speed = Distance/Time = 240/4 = 60 km/h. Verify: 60×4=240 ✓. Trap: 50 = 200/4 (wrong distance); 80 = 320/4 (wrong distance).

questions.stem: A train travels at 50 km/h. How far does it travel in 3 hours?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Distance = Speed × Time = 50×3 = 150 km. Verify: 50×3=150 ✓. Trap: 120 = 40×3 (wrong speed); 165 = 55×3 (wrong speed).

questions.stem: A cyclist covers 300 km at 60 km/h. How long does the journey take?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Time = Distance/Speed = 300/60 = 5 hours. Verify: 60×5=300 ✓. Trap: 6 = 300/50 (wrong speed denominator); 4 = 300/75 (wrong).

questions.stem: A and B start from the same point, walking in the same direction. A walks at 6 km/h and B at 9 km/h. After how many hours will B be 12 km ahead of A?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Relative speed (same direction) = 9−6 = 3 km/h. Time to create 12 km gap = 12/3 = 4 hours. Verify: in 4h, A covers 24 km; B covers 36 km; difference=12 km ✓. Trap: 2 = gap/half relative speed; 6 = 12/2 (divides by 2, not relative speed). Key: when two move in same direction, relative speed = DIFFERENCE.

questions.stem: Two trains, 120 m and 80 m long, travel towards each other at 60 km/h and 40 km/h. How long do they take to cross each other?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Relative speed (opposite directions) = 60+40 = 100 km/h = 100×1000/3600 = 250/9 m/s. Total distance to cross = 120+80 = 200 m. Time = 200/(250/9) = 200×9/250 = 7.2 seconds. Verify: 7.2×(250/9)=7.2×27.78=200m ✓. Trap: 5.6 = uses sum of lengths as 160 (wrong); 9.6 = uses wrong relative speed. Key: crossing = sum of train lengths; opposite direction = add speeds.

questions.stem: A train 200 m long passes a 300 m platform in 25 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Total distance to cover a platform = train length + platform length = 200+300 = 500 m. Speed = 500/25 = 20 m/s. Convert to km/h: 20×3600/1000 = 72 km/h. Verify: 72×1000/3600=20 m/s; 20×25=500m ✓. Trap: 60 km/h = only platform distance: 300/25=12m/s=43.2km/h (wrong); 80 km/h = uses only train distance 200m somehow.

questions.stem: A man covers the first half of a journey at 40 km/h and the second half at 60 km/h. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
questions.explanation: A is correct. For equal DISTANCES (not times), average speed = 2S₁S₂/(S₁+S₂) = 2×40×60/(40+60) = 4800/100 = 48 km/h. Verify with 120 km total: First 60 km at 40 km/h = 1.5h; next 60 km at 60 km/h = 1h; total time=2.5h; avg speed=120/2.5=48 km/h ✓. Trap: 50 = arithmetic mean (40+60)/2 = 50; this is WRONG when distances are equal (only correct when times are equal).

questions.stem: A runs 1.5 km in 9 minutes; B runs the same distance in 7.5 minutes. In a race of 1.5 km, by how many seconds does B beat A?
questions.explanation: C is correct. A's time = 9 minutes = 540 seconds. B's time = 7.5 minutes = 450 seconds. B beats A by 540−450 = 90 seconds. Verify: A takes 9 min, B takes 7.5 min for same distance; difference = 1.5 min = 90 seconds ✓. Trap: 60 seconds = 1 minute (underestimates the difference); 120 seconds = 2 minutes (overestimates).

questions.stem: A leaves town X at 6 AM walking at 40 km/h. B leaves the same town at 8 AM in the same direction at 60 km/h. At what time will B catch up with A?
questions.explanation: C is correct. By 8 AM (when B starts), A has been walking 2 hours at 40 km/h → A is 80 km ahead. Relative speed of B catching up = 60−40 = 20 km/h. Time for B to close 80 km gap = 80/20 = 4 hours after 8 AM = 12 PM. Verify: at 12 PM, A has walked 6h×40=240 km; B has walked 4h×60=240 km. Same distance ✓. Trap: 10 AM = 2h after B starts (gap = 80km; 2h×20=40km, only half closed).

questions.stem: A journey from P to Q has two legs: P to R (60 km at 20 km/h) and R to Q (60 km at 30 km/h). What is the average speed for the whole journey?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Total distance = 60+60 = 120 km. Time for P→R: 60/20 = 3h. Time for R→Q: 60/30 = 2h. Total time = 5h. Average speed = 120/5 = 24 km/h. Formula: 2×20×30/(20+30) = 1200/50 = 24 km/h (valid since distances are equal). Trap: 25 = arithmetic mean (20+30)/2 = 25 (wrong for equal DISTANCES); 22 = wrong calculation.
